text: Your best work happens on a Tuesday night shift. And by Wednesday, nobody remembers it.
I've led two improvement projects. My CV still just says staff nurse. I don't even know how to write it down.
That's exactly what Evinca is for. Not just an award, but a place to learn, record and share your growth. Here is what you actually get, and what it costs you to start. Nothing.
Start with a free Spotlight Story. You get a private story page, with an eligibility check. A watermarked certificate preview. And up to three colleague confirmations.
It stays private, so you can build it at your own pace. When you're ready, verify it, and it's published in that month's gallery, with a dated certificate, a badge and a social card.
And here's the part most people miss. Every application comes with a set of studios. They grow with you, level by level, and they stay yours, whatever the outcome of the review.

Starter, with a free Spotlight Story, opens the Gifts Studio. Practice, with a verified Spotlight, adds the Career Studio. And Professional, with a Distinction or an Honour, opens every Academy course.
The Gifts Studio comes with your free story. Appreciation cards for colleagues. A digital business card. And a development planner.
Pick a goal, and it builds your next ninety days. Establish, apply, consolidate. Small, dated steps that actually move you forward.
Verify your Spotlight, and the Career Studio opens. An A T S friendly C V, a cover letter, a professional profile, and an appraisal pack. All built from your own evidence.
So my improvement projects finally go on my CV. With proof.
And the Evinca Academy. Seven self-paced courses in A I prompting, quality improvement and leadership, with worked examples, assessments and a certificate of completion.
Healthcare A I Prompt Studio. Q I Storyboard Creator. Kaizen in Healthcare. The skills behind great evidence, so your next project is stronger than your last.
Reach the annual Honour, and you're named in the annual issue, with a free cover set. Your own magazine cover, stating what was measured, what it was compared with, and its limits.
Even before you apply, there's plenty to read for free. The Evinca Review magazine. Essays, profiles, and method notes on the work behind the outcome.
And practical guides. How to write a nomination reviewers believe. A ten point checklist to tell a real award from a vanity one. And how to add an award to LinkedIn and your CV, the right way.

Lead a team? Hospitals use Evinca to recognise staff with independent review. Because, as the research on this page shows, it's not whether you recognise your staff. It's whether the recognition means anything.
Okay. I'm writing my story tonight.
Learn it. Record it. Share it. Your work already made a difference. Start free today, at Evinca dot Healthcare Crown Academy dot co dot uk.
